digest.component_or_area: rebar bridge status and canary health monitoring
propositions: Create canonical `rebar bridge status` subcommand reading authoritative durable state from `refs/reconciler/last-pass` with re-introduced `bridge-status` compatibility alias using identical parser and core.

Consolidate duplicate pass-record producers into one reconciler finalization writer that records success and process-surviving hard failure to last-pass ref using compare-and-swap with exactly three retries before lock release.
Implement exact verdict precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY with corresponding exit codes; NEVER_RUN when no durable record and no live lock.
Environment identity derives from explicit REBAR_ENV_ID (wins) or stable local:<repo-env-id> from .env-id; missing/empty .env-id is a hard configuration error for writer and status.
Canary detects crash by comparing two read-only lock snapshots separated by observed lease_secs; unchanged OID/fence indicates CRASHED while advancing fence means RUNNING.

Stage rollout with explicit REBAR_CANARY_HEARTBEAT_SOURCE=github-api until producer writes last-pass once, then default to canonical status; reject observed leases over 480 seconds as operational failure.
